Dark Iron Looter and Dark Iron Engineer.text: The intro mobs are not too serious, and the trash only gets challenging once you get to the Dark Iron side. The «N263396»s deal rapid auto attacks with their daggers, and pulling too many at once can really drain your tank's health fast! The «N263397» will throw bombs at their target location.

Dark Iron Summoner and Fiery Assistant.text: «N263438» is a caster-type mob that casts Fireballs and will summon a «S1291218»

Lesser Stone Golem.text: These «N263466»s deal intense damage and have increased movement speed.

Faldrim Anvilmar.text: «N261306» patrols the center of Anvilmar's Rest and is a simple tank-and-spank fight. The main concern from this is accidentally pulling the boss with any trash should it patrol too close to your party. Clear out a section of the room, wait for him to patrol to your side, then pull. He will auto-attack and cast Mind Blast , and will apply a 10-minute Curse of Anvilmar to the tank.

Magmatus.text: «N261316» is accompanied by a «N263438» and has a couple of abilities that really put a focus on healing. On pull, the tank should pull the boss away from the rest of the party, focusing down the Summoner, as the boss will cast a Fire Nova -like ability every so often. After the Summoner is taken down, focus the boss down. Magmatus will also cast Combust on a random player

Plunder.text: «N261311» patrols his hallway and only has one ability: a Knockback . All you need to do is pull this boss into a safe area where you won't get knocked into any other mobs. Have everyone positioned against a wall or corner to add additional mitigation to this mechanic.

Dirgen Dirgehammer.text: «N261319» is the final encounter here. This boss is accompanied by two «N263466»s, with «N263396»s around the edge of the room. Before starting this encounter, take out all the looters, as the boss has an AoE Fear and a Rend. This is heavy damage on your tank, so take out each golem one by one and use stuns and fears to mitigate damage.

Oggleflint.text: «N11517» is flanked by 2 troggs in his room. Make sure to CC at least one trogg before engaging him. Allow your tank to pick up the remaining add and face Oggleflint away from the group (cleave). All dps should work to nuke down the add first as before switching to Oggleflint. Make sure to kill the CC'ed add once the boss and the first add are dead.

Taragaman the Hungerer.text: «N11520» is stationed in the middle of a platform surrounded by lava. Have your tank pull him away from the edges of the platform so that «S18072» does not knock him off the platform. Make sure your range is at max range so «S11970» inflicts minimal damage. The rest of the fight is a basic tank-and-spank.

Jergosh the Invoker.text: Like Oggleflint, «N11518» is flanked by two mobs. One of the mobs should be CC'ed while the other is focused down before transitioning to Jergosh. He casts «S20800» and «S18267» which can be a problem for tanks trying to gain threat and intense on healers, but overall this is a simple and straightforward fight.

Bazzalan.text: «N11519» also has 2 adds, but the mob on the right (his left) can be pulled without engaging the boss, greatly reducing the difficulty of the fight. The other mob should be CC'ed while the group focuses on the boss as he deals significant single-target damage and should be killed ASAP. Other than that, another tank-and-spank.

The \"Spider Wing\".text: The intro mobs are not too serious, and these spider mobs, «N250735», «N250484», «N250488», are just grouped in packs and can patrol the area.

Skeletal Soldiers and Banshees.text: «N250626» are physical undead soldiers that patrol the area near The Baron, along with «N250617»s near the area

Flesh Golem.text: These «N255109»s deal intense damage and have a threat-reducing Knock Away ability.

Ghouls and Ragged Ghouls.text: «N250483» patrols King's Alley and is a simple tank-and-spank fight. They're accompanied by two spider mobs, and those should be taken down asap. Use stuns to make this fight easier and cleanse the Leech Poison debuff off of the tank when applied.

Witherfang.text: «N250483» patrols King's Alley and is a simple tank-and-spank fight. They're accompanied by two spider mobs, and those should be taken down asap. Use stuns to make this fight easier and cleanse the Leech Poison debuff off of the tank when applied.

The Baron.text: «N250660» is a hard-hitting boss with one main ability, Knockout . This deals high instant damage and has a threat drop in it. If your tank is not at full HP, this ability can kill the tank. Use stuns to keep the boss from casting this.

Viktor The Vile.text: «N256035» is found when players activate the fire in the chimney located in the building to the southwest in Lordamere Overlook by the Lordaeron Graveyard. Players must clear 5 waves of adds before fighting Viktor. He only has powerful melee swings and the same Leech Poison ability as Witherfang, so make sure you let the tank get aggro first

The Abandoned.text: «N250631» will be found as soon as you enter Market Street from Lordamere Overlook. The statue in this area will trigger 3 waves of adds before The Abandoned comes out. He will Frost Nova players, apply a chill effect to those who physically hit him, and cast Drain Life on the tank.

Bjork.text: «N256097» only has one ability: a very short Anti-Magic Shield . It goes away pretty fast, so this boss is a very quick tank and spank.

Rath'Mael.text: «N250657» has one ability: Flamestrike . Move out of it as soon as he channels the cast, as it's always cast where the tank was when the cast started. You can also stun him to prevent him from casting it altogether.

Shadowfang Moonwalker.text: The «N3853» is a Worgen-like mob located primarily in the courtyard of Shadowfang Keep. They have one notable ability, «S24021», which makes them immune to all magical spells for 10 seconds.

Wailing Guardsman.text: «N3877» is a ghostly humanoid mob that can be found on the upper levels of Shadowfang Keep. They have one primary ability, «S7074», which silences all players within 5 yards for 5 seconds.

Rethilgore.text: «N3914» is a tank and spank in the truest sense of the word. His only ability, Soul Drain, is negligable. He also has a moderately low health pool and a Loot table comparable to his difficulty. The only thing you should be aware of are the mobs surrounding him, 2 of which should be pulled prior to engaging the boss. The one mob that will remain, a Bleak Worg, should be polymorphed or burned down first prior to switching DPS to Rethilgore.

Fel Steeds / Shadow Charger.text: The «N3864» and «N3865» deal an incredibly high amount of damage and pulling one of them will pull all three, regardless of how carefully you pull the first mob. Make sure to polymorph at least one of the horses and have a hunter or warlock pet tank the second while your main tank and DPS is focused on the third before cycling to the next mob. Your healer should be aware of the massive amount of damage that will be incoming during this encounter.

Razorclaw the Butcher.text: «N3886» is a simple tank and spank. Make sure to clear the room before you pull him, as well as the surrounding patrols. His Abilities are negligible, and no further explanation is required.

Baron Silverlaine.text: What makes «N3887» challenging is his higher level (24) and his primary ability, Veil of Shadow. This ability reduces healing effects on a target by 75%, effectively serving as a beefed up mortal strike. Make sure your hybrid classes are assisting the healer here with tank healing as the tank will go down quickly otherwise. Aside from that, the fight is a tank and spank.

Commander Springvale.text: «N4278» is flanked by two mobs that will pull with him. The first is a Haunted Servitor, which should be burned down quickly. The second is a Wailing Guardsman, which would pulled by either a hunter or warlock pet away from the group as it can cast an AOE silence that can potentially wipe the party. Make sure to prioritize Springvale after the Servitor is killed, and interrupt his healing spells. Once he's down, take out the guardsman who again should be tanked off to the side by either a pet or possibly a Warrior/Druid offtank.

Odo the Blindwatcher.text: «N4279» is flanked by 2 «N3866» which will pull with him once engaged. These bats have a disarm and a cleave ability, so they should be faced away from the group while being tanked. One of the bats may be polymorphed if you have a mage. Make sure to let the tank generate some threat before going ham on the boss as the disarm can be quite annoying to deal. Kill the bats first before switching over to Odo, and you should be fine.

Deathsworn Captain (Rare).text: «N3872» is a rare elite that should be tanked away from the group as his cleave ability can do a severe amount of damage. If you will him with any wailing guardsmen, make sure to tank him at least 10 yards away from the guardsman to avoid the AOE silence. Aside from that, the fight is a tank and spank.

Fenrus the Devourer.text: «N4274» is an easy enough boss, with their only notable ability being a DoT. This encounter is a straightforward tank and spank.

Wolf Master Nandos.text: Four Worgs circle «N3927» in a barn-like room, make sure to kill all Worgs before engaging him. If you pull the Worgs alongside him, make sure to kill them first before transitioning back to Nandos. He will summon Worgs periodically throughout the fight. Make sure to kill them instantly before switching back to Nandos. This fight is all about prioritizing adds first so if you can do that you will be fine.

Archmage Arugal.text: Arugal is by far the hardest boss in the dungeon. His Void Bolts hit for a massive amount of damage, and his teleport makes him difficult to lock down. To make this as easy as possible, have your ranged DPS stand on the platform as soon as you enter his room. They should be able to DPS Arugal down from that point no matter where he teleports. Have your melee DPS stand there as well and wait for Argual's teleport to their location, so they don't end up lining the healer while trying to chase him down.

Noteworthy BoE Drops.text: Shadowfang Keep drops some particularly strong items that includes several powerful and visually attractive weapons for both casters and melee. These are highly valued as level 19 twink gear and have low drop chances from trash mobs within the dungeon.

Goblin Engineer and Craftsman.text: «N1731» and «N622» are two of the most vicious mobs in all of The Deadmines. They can be found in the Goblin Foundry before engaging with Gilnid. They are most notable for their «S3605» ability, which summons a deadly miniature robot to attack players once cast.

Defias Squallshaper.text: «N1732» is a caster-type mob that is located in the Dreadnaught room of The Deadmines. They are noteworthy due to their «S122» ability, which can be frustrating for tanks and melee.

Dungeon Patrols.text: There are many different dungeon patrols in The Deadmines. They often catch groups off guard after boss kills, as most groups will drop their guard while looting, rolling, and eating/drinking.

Rhahk'zor.text: «N644» is flanked by 2 «N1725» in his room. Both of them can be pulled without pulling Rhahk'Zor himself. If you are unable to pull them cleanly, make sure to CC at least one archer once to limit the incoming damage your group will be taking. Also, beware of any patrolling elites that might aggro after the pull. Aside from that, this fight is a simple tank-and-spank as Rhahk'Zor is little more than a pseudo-boss and warmup for the dungeon.

Miner Johnson (Rare).text: «N3586» is the epitome of a tank-and-spank. He has one single target ability that reduces the tanks armor, so aside from the fight requiring intensive tank healing, it is a straightforward encounter. The only problem is that he is surrounded by numerous «N598». However, they are non-elites with small health pools. Try to pick as many of them off as possible before pulling Johnson. I recommend that if you happen to have a hybrid DPS class in your group, have the hybrid also heal the tank when the «S12097» debuff is up to guarantee the kill.

Sneed’s Shredder.text: The «N642» fight begins before pulling the boss. Due to the Shredder's «S7399» ability, the entire room must be cleared of all «N641». Otherwise, players might be feared into them and cause a wipe. Aside from clearing the room, the boss is a very straightforward tank-and-spank. Once the Shredder has been defeated, «N643» will hop out of the machine and continue the fight himself. He has a disarm ability that can be annoying for tanks trying to pick up aggro, so give the tank ample time to acquire threat before going ham on the boss. Overall, this is a simple boss encounter.

Gilnid.text: «N1763» like many of the bosses in this dungeon, is mostly a simple tank-and-spank. He is flanked by a «N622» that will pull once Gilnid has been engaged. Make sure to CC the engineer as he may cast «S3605», which summons a mechanical robot that is immune to most abilities. If the robot does get summoned, focus the engineer that summoned it as the robot will despawn once its summoner is dead. You can avoid this headache by simply CCing the add before the pull.

Mr. Smite.text: «N646» and two invisible «N636» engage automatically as you approach the plank leading up to him. Smite casts «S6432» at 66% and 33% health, stunning the group for 10 seconds, so the Blackguards need to be killed before the boss reaches 66%. During these stuns, the boss will run to a chest and pick up a weapon and adding new abilities. After 33%, make sure the tank is topped up to avoid sudden death during a «S6435». Aside from the adds and stuns, this is a straightforward encounter.

Captain Greenskin.text: Be sure to CC one of the adds next to «N647» before the pull. I recommend that you CC the «N1732» as their frost nova ability can be quite annoying. Once you've engaged the boss, begin by killing the «N3450» first as it is non-elite and will die quickly. After that, kill the remaining «N657» and then swap to Greenskin while keeping your CC on the Squallshaper. Make sure to face Greenskin away from the group as his cleave can be quite nasty. When he dies, finish off the Squallshaper and loot his corpse.

Edwin VanCleef.text: When you engage «N639», two «N636» will break stealth and attack you as well. Like Mr. Smite, make sure to deal with these mobs first. CC one and 'skull' mark the other and burn it down quickly, as Van Cleef does a tremendous amount of single-target damage and can shred your tank. Once both of the adds are dealt with, focus back on VC. Once he hits 50% health, he will summon 2 more adds for you to deal with. It remains quite heal-intensive so the healers and hybrids in your group should be on their toes and provide spot-healing as it is needed. will drop the first time you kill VanCleef.

Cookie.text: The most challenging part about «N645» is the leap off the ship to engage him. The bottom deck of the ship is packed with elites that can easily aggro if a jump is not timed correctly. Assuming you've timed the jump correctly, pull Cookie off the ship towards the exit of the dungeon. The fight is a simple tank-and-spank. Make sure to interrupt the «S5174» spell as it heals Cookie for a fair chunk. The rest is easy.

Defias Prisoner.text: «N1706» is one of the most tedious mobs in the entire Stockade, with their «S6713» making it difficult for tanks to generate threat. Whenever you're going up against a group of multiple Prisoners, DPS should give the tank adequate time to build threat before attacking, and CC if they can.

Targorr the Dread.text: A few Defias surround «N1696» in his room. Make sure to CC at least one Defias before engaging him. Allow your tank to pick up the remaining add and Targorr and station him away from the CC'ed add. All DPS should work to nuke down the add first as before switching to Targorr. Make sure to kill the CC'ed add once the boss and the first add are dead.

Kam Deepfury.text: Like Targorr and many of the other bosses in this dungeon, «N1666» is surrounded by a few Defias in his room. Make sure to CC at least one Defias before engaging him. Allow your tank to pick up the remaining add and Kam and station him away from the CC'ed add. All DPS should work to nuke down the add first as before switching to Kam. Make sure to kill the CC'ed add once the boss and the first add are dead.

Hamhock.text: Two Defias flank «N1717». Make sure to CC at least one Defias before engaging him. Allow your tank to pick up the remaining add and Hamhock and station him away from the CC'ed add. All DPS should work to nuke down the add first as before switching to Hamhock. Be wary of his «S421» ability, which can be nasty in melee heavy groups. Make sure to spread out as much as possible to reduce its damage.

Bazil Thredd.text: «N1716» is a simple tank and spank in theory, but his high level and «S7964» make him difficult for some groups. Make sure to keep the tank topped off, so he/she does not die during a smoke bomb stun. Bazil deals a high amount of single target damage, so if you have any hybrid DPS in your group, make sure to have them support the healer and spot-heal the tank when needed.

Dextren Ward.text: «N1663» is one of the most challenging bosses in this dungeon due to his «S5246». Make sure to clear all of the adds in the surrounding corridors, so no one in your group mistakenly pulls additional adds during the fear duration. If you pull extra Defias mobs with Dextren, make sure to CC them as best you can and focus down Dextren first, as his fear can be tremendously punishing. If you have done a good job with clearing the adds and the rooms around him, this fight should be no problem at all.

Bruegal Ironknuckle (Rare).text: «N1720» is simple, straightforward, and drops the best loot the dungeon has to offer. However, because he is a rare spawn, you are unlikely to find him during your run. Make sure to clear the adds around him before engaging. He is the literal definition of a tank and spank.

Boss Drops.text: While bosses in this dungeon have a chance to drop Uncommon Items , only the rare «N1720» reliably drops valuable gear.

Druid of the Fang.text: «N3840» is the first and only notable trash mob you will come across in the Wailing Caverns. They are hard-hitting casters with some abilities to be watchful. The first ability, «S8040», will put an enemy target to sleep for up to 15 seconds. The problem with this ability is that it can also target healers, effectively neutralizing them for 15 seconds.

Kresh.text: «N3653» is a straightforward tank and spank, featuring only one ability that occasionally dazes its target. Kresh has a large amount of armor and base damage, and if you have a melee-heavy group, this fight can drag on and be a slight nuisance for your healer. Overall, this is not a challenging encounter.

Lady Andacondra.text: «N3671» is likely to be the first of the Druid bosses you will encounter in the Wailing Caverns. Like all of the druids, she has four abilities, 2 of which are shared by her contemporaries («S9532» and «S700»). Her most threatening ability is 'Sleep,' which can be applied to anyone in your party, including the Tank or Healer. To deal with this ability, make sure to interrupt it immediately. If you happen to pull another Druid of the Fang during the encounter, make sure to CC it right away as one 'Sleep' can be dealt with, but 2 or more will result in a wipe. If your interrupts are on point and you've pulled carefully, this fight should be easy.

Lord Cobrahn.text: Before the pull, «N3669» will be surrounded by 3 «N8886». They are between levels 18 and 19, and are non-elites, making them easy to AOE down. Prioritize these pythons before switching to Cobrahn. Like all of the Druids in the Wailing Caverns, Cobrahn may cast the dangerous Sleep ability, which should be interrupted immediately, especially if the target is your healer. At some point during the encounter, Cobrahn will transform into a serpent, increasing his damage by 50 and attack speed by 43%.

Deviate Faerie Dragon (Rare).text: «N5912» is a low armor, high damage mob that possesses no significant abilities. The challenge in this encounter comes from the fact that this is a 4-mob pull, all of which are elites. Two Druids of the Fang are also included in this pull, meaning that «S8040» is likely to go off in this fight. Your strategy should be to CC one of the Druids while burning the other one down and interrupting its 'Sleep' whenever possible. Your tank will be taking damage from 3 different elites here, so if you have any hybrid classes in your group aside from the healer, make sure that they weave in some support heals during their rotation. This fight will test your group's ability to focus down a single target, so if you're coordinated and all on the same page, it should be a breeze.

Lord Pythas.text: «N3670», like his fellow Druid counterparts, is most dangerous due to his 'Sleep' ability. Additionally, he is flanked by one additional Druid of the Fang and a «N5761». Make sure to CC the Druid and interrupt Pythas whenever he casts Sleep. Prioritize the Shambler and burn it down before switching to Pythas, but make sure either your tank or one melee DPS stays focused on Pythas, so the Sleep is interrupted.

Skum.text: «N3674» is a simple tank-and-spank boss with only one significant ability; Chained Bolt. This is a chain lightning-style spell that will strike three melee units if they are close together. Make sure your melee spread out around the boss to avoid the damage. Spreading out is not a hard requirement, as the ability itself deals minimal damage. Skum is entirely optional, but his loot makes him worthwhile.

Lord Serpentis.text: «N3673» is the last of the 4 Druids of the Fang. He shares abilities with his counterparts and is only dangerous due to his Sleep ability. As with the other Druids, interrupt Sleep, and the fight is a cakewalk. Unlike the other Druids, Serptenis can be pulled without any additional trash, making this encounter easier than the rest.

Verdan the Everliving.text: «N5775» has one significant ability, which roots all targets within 10 yards for 10 seconds and knocks them down for 2 seconds. The ability does damage as well, so healers should keep their eye on the group's health pools. Ranged DPS should stand at max range to avoid the root. Aside from that, Verdan is a tank-and-spank and should always be killed to unlock the waterfall shortcut behind him.

Naralax Event Mutanus the Devourer.text: The first part of the event is simple; escort the Disciple through the Wailing Caverns towards the ritual stone. To escort him, will require you to clear out any remaining adds on the way to the rock, most of which should already be cleared by progressing through the dungeon. Once the Disciple reaches Naralex and begins his final ritual, waves of adds will approach the Disciple to kill him. Burn down the adds while keeping your AOE DPS alive. After the 2nd wave of adds, Mutanus will appear to kill your group and the Disciple. He is very challenging, as he possesses two forms of crowd control that can be used against your group. Additionally, his «S8150» ability does a massive amount of damage to nearby targets, making this fight a nightmare for your melee DPS. Mutanus is a group composition check - make sure to have a healthy set of ranged DPS and at least one hybrid healing class aside from your main healer to assist with the thunderclap damage. There are no special tricks for this fight - stay at max range while healing up the group and try to stay alive. This fight is worth the trouble, as the loot is quite good.

Roogug.text: «N6168» is optional and tied to the Shaman- and Warrior-exclusive class quests. Roogug is a simple encounter with one notable exception: the surrounding mobs. Before engaging Roogug, make sure to clear the area and CC whatever mobs you can prior to engagement. If you have a Warlock with Banish, make sure to use it on the elemental at his side to reduce incoming damage onto the tank.

Aggem Thorncurse.text: «N4424» is a simple tank and spank with the ability to summon a boar guardian to aide him in battle. When he summons the boar, prioritize it and kill it before switching back to Aggem.

Death Speaker Jargba.text: «N4428» pulls with two caster mobs, making this fight quite tough. With his «S14515» ability, Jargba can turn the tides of battle by MCing one of your party members. Additionally, the caster allies do massive amounts of damage. In order to survive this engagement, you must CC at least 1 of the mobs beside Jargba, ideally both. Take the boss out quickly to get rid of the MC threat, and then finish off the casters to ensure victory.

Overlord Ramtusk.text: «N4420» is a vivaciously strong boss with high single target damage. He is also flanked by 2 «N4438», whose «S8259» ability makes them particularly lethal. In order to prevent your tank from getting decimated, make sure to CC both of the spearhides if you can. From there, focus down Ramtusk for an easy kill.

Agathelos the Raging.text: «N4422» is a straightforward encounter, though this boss deals massive single-target damage. Most of this fight's difficulty is keeping the tank alive, which will fall on the healer and any hybrid DPS your group might have.

Blind Hunter.text: «N4425» is a simple fight that takes place inside the Bat Cave in RFK. Make sure your casters stop casting when he begins casting his «S8281» (Sonic Boom), which is an AOE silence ability. Aside from that, the fight is a simple tank and spank with fantastic loot. This Rare can be tamed by Hunters and is a sought-after pet.

Earthcaller Halmgar.text: If you have a Warlock with Banish, use it on the elemental and kill «N4842». Otherwise, clear the platform, prioritize his totems, and burst the elemental down quickly before switching to Halmgar.

Charlga Razorflank.text: «N4421» is a caster that deals quite a bit of damage but has low armor. Pull the boss down from her hut and tank her on the platform below. Make sure to interrupt her casts and have your group spread out to avoid extra damage. Every so often, Charlga will go immune to all abilities and also has a healing spell, extending the duration of the fight. Compared to Ramtusk and Jargba, this should be a piece of cake.

Tuten'kash.text: «N7355» is summoned through the spider gong event in RFD. Before you engage him, you will first have to clear a few waves of spiders. After each wave is finished, ring the gong again to summon the next wave. The waves are simple and straightforward, as is Tuten'kash. The tank should face him away from the group to avoid unnecessary web spray, but his other abilities are negligible.

Mordresh Fire Eye.text: «N7357» is a low-armor cast boss that can be bursted down easily by melee dps. Before you engage him, make sure to clear all of the skeletons dancing beside the bone pile. The last pack of skeletons will pull the boss, so make sure to AOE them down quickly to prevent a wipe. Interrupt Mordresh's hard-hitting fireball when you can and this should be an easy win.

Glutton.text: «N8567» is a simple tank and spank. Make sure to stay out of his Disease Clouds and be prepared to heal the tank through significant amounts of damage when the boss casts Enrage.

Ragglesnout.text: «N7354»'s «S7645» is by far the most important ability in this encounter. If your tank or healer get MCed, make sure to have your hybrids fill in where needed. Interrupt his heal to prevent a longer encounter and his Shadow Bolts to minimize incoming damage.

Amnennar the Coldbringer.text: «N7358» is a challenging dungeon boss that should be tanked facing the tent where he stands to neutralize «S13009». Have your group stack on the tank to reduce the severity of «S15531», and switch to the spirit that he summons as soon as it spawns. Interrupt «S15530» and prioritize proper positioning.

Plaguemaw the Rotting.text: «N7356» is the final boss of an optional escort event. When Belnistrasz begins his ritual, focus down mobs that spawn one at a time, preferably with an offtank pulling adds off Belnistrasz. Plaguemaw is a straightforward tank and spank.

Baelog.text: «N6906» (level 41 elite), «N6907» (level 40 elite) and «N6908» (level 40 elite) make up The Lost Dwarves. They are friendly to Alliance players but hostile to the Horde. Most groups crowd control «N6906», have the tank pick up «N6908», and burst down «N6907» as he can cast «S20252» on party members, which results in a pesky stun. Once «N6907» is done for, move on to «N6908» while keeping «N6906» CC'd. As long as the room is clear, you shouldn't have much trouble. Don't forget to loot the chest behind The Lost Dwarves.

Revelosh.text: «N6910» is a level 40 elite trogg. Revelosh is linked with two «N4851», so when you pull him, they will also join the battle. You could try to CC one of the «N4851» if you've got it. Otherwise, try to burn down «N6910» as quickly as possible. His «S16033» can deal a lot of damage to your party, so take priority in interrupting whenever he gets ready to cast it.

Ironaya.text: «N7228» is a level 40 giant. To summon her, you need to combine the item from the chest behind The Lost Dwarves with a drop from «N6910», then place the combined item in the model of a city-looking keystone within the next room. She has high armor, lots of HP, is immune to damage-over-time (DoT) effects and can knock players back. Have your tank pick her up and face her away from the rest of the group to avoid her «S8374». Ranged, spread out. Keeping her abilities in mind, it's a fairly straightforward tank & spank type fight.

Obsidian Sentinel.text: «N7023» is a level 44 elite golem found right by the Back Entrance. He's got high armor, high HP, and DoT immunity. At 66% and 33% health, he will spawn two non-elite «N7209». Groups typically kill the two «N7209» first, then return back to the boss.

Ancient Stone Keeper.text: «N7206» is a level 44 elite golem. Like the golem mobs you fought along your way, he's also got high armor, high HP, DoT immunity and a nasty AoE slow & silence ability: «S10094».

Galgann Firehammer.text: «N7291» awaits you with two «N7030» by his side. Between these 3 NPCs, there's a lot of AoE magic damage flying around. Tanks, pick up «N7291» and separate him from the group, keeping him faced away. CC one «N7030», kill the other one, then kill the one that was CC'd. Once both are dead, focus on «N7291». His range of fire attacks can be devastating. If able to, dispel any of his fire buffs that he'll cast on your party as they will amplify his fire damage.

Grimlok.text: «N4854» comes with a «N4853», «N4855» and a «N4863» all grouped up together. Many groups will opt to burn down «N4854» as quickly as possible, while CCing one of the adds. Killing «N4854» quickly can result in him dying before being able to cast his group «S7289». After he dies, focus on the «N4853» next, and then finish off the remaining 2 adds.

Archaedas.text: «N2748» has a lot of HP and summons non-elite adds throughout the encounter. Make sure your group burns the adds down as quickly as possible. At 20%, he will summon 4 elite adds, who die when he dies. At this point in the fight, many groups opt to burn «N2748» down as quickly as possible. This is a long fight and will require the entire group to perform in order to defeat. Remember to use potions, bandages, cooldowns, and everything you've got!

Antu'sul.text: «N8127» is a level 48 elite Sandfury Troll. Antu'sul is a difficult boss due to his ability to summon «N8138» and «N8156» during the encounter. When this happens, all dps should immediately AOE down the additional mobs and prioritize them over the boss. The tank should be ready to interrupt the healing abilities, and melee dps should prioritize totems as soon as they're up. This boss is quite mechanically intensive for a dungeon boss in Vanilla, and requires all parties fulfilling their roles for a successful attempt.

Theka the Martyr.text: «N7272» is a level 46 elite Sandfury Troll, a quest-related mini-boss found in the Scarab room of ZF. At 30%, he becomes immune to physical damage and shadow damage for 30 seconds, making Mages a valuable asset in the dungeon. He is a simple tank and spank, but once he goes immune, he will begin aggroing nearby scarabs to aide him in battle. Focus down Theka first before finishing off the scarabs.

Witch Doctor Zum'rah.text: «N7271» is a level 46 elite Sandfury Troll. Zum'rah is a challenging boss that is quite intensive on the healers. Interrupts are paramount during this fight in order to prevent unnecessary damage from his shadow bolt volley. Throughout the engagement, Zum'rah will summon zombies from nearby graves to attack your group. Make sure to switch over to the zombies immediately as they are summoned and burn them down fast. Whenever Zum'rah spawns a totem, prioritize it as well. This is a chaotic fight but if the totem and adds are prioritized, it shouldn't be too difficult.

Nekrum Gutchewer.text: «N7796» and «N7275» are level 46 and 47 elite Sandfury Trolls who spawn as the last wave of the stairs event in Zul'Farrak. The best strategy to deal with these two is to burn down Nekrum first. He has fewer abilities and is lower level, meaning less chance to dodge/miss/resist spells. Make sure one of your melee interrupts Sezz'ziz's heal in the meantime.

Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz.text: «N7796» and «N7275» spawn as the last wave of the stairs event in Zul'Farrak. Burn down Nekrum first; he has fewer abilities and is lower level. In the meantime, keep one of your melee on interrupt duty for Sezz'ziz's heal, and switch to Sezz'ziz once his partner is down.

Sergeant Bly.text: «N7604» is a level 45 elite human who is engaged after the stairs event in Zul'Farrak. He is accompanied by several other elite mobs, namely «N7606» and «N7608». Between Oro's AOE and Murta's healing, this fight can be quite challenging. Prioritize Oro and Murta before switching to Bly.

Hydromancer Velratha.text: «N7795» is a level 46 elite Sandfury Troll located near the end of Zul'Farrak. Velratha is a simple tank and spank, but tests a group's situational awareness. Velratha patrols around the room, which is riddled with elite Sandfury. Make sure that you pull her ALONE, otherwise a wipe is likely. Once you've pulled her safely, interrupt her casts and you should be fine.

Gahz'rilla.text: «N7273» is a level 46 elite Hydra located at the end of Zul'Farrak. He is summoned by using the Mallet on the gong near the aqueduct. Make sure to clear out the room where Gahz'rilla is summoned from. Tank him with the tank's back against a wall and stack on the tank to prevent being thrown up into the air. The rest of the fight is a tank and spank.

Chief Ukorz Sandscalp.text: «N7267» is a level 48 elite Sandfury Troll, and is accompanied by a level 46 elite «N7797». Make sure to face these two away from the group. Melee should stay behind them to avoid the cleave. Kill Ruuzlu first.

Zerillis.text: «N10082» is a level 45 rare-elite Sandfury Troll that patrols throughout Zul'Farrak. Pull him into melee range immediately (you might need to LoS). Simple tank and spank.

Lord Vyletongue.text: «N12236» is a level 49 elite accompanied by two stealthed «N11792» guards. If the entire group stacks on «N12236», you negate his ability to use Auto Shot & «S14443», so have everyone stack close together on the tank. He'll use «S1953» to get away, so make sure you are quick to stack up again whenever he does so. Most groups DPS «N12236» down first since he is mobile and can move around the room. Once he's down, finish off his two guards.

Noxxion.text: «N13282» is a level 48 elite and the first boss found in the Ambershard Side. He has an AoE «S21687» ability as well as a knockback called «S18072». After a little while, «N13282» will split into smaller versions of himself. Once they're all defeated, «N13282» will reform, and the fight will continue. Some groups opt to pull him out of the pool, to make killing the adds easier.

Razorlash.text: Continue down Foulspore Cavern and you'll run into «N12258». Some groups opt to skip this boss encounter, as it isn't mandatory to kill him to advance forward. «N12258» is a level 48 elite and the second boss found in the Ambershard Side. His «S15976» causes a painful DoT (damage over time) tick for 10 seconds, and an AoE «S15284» ability for those in melee range. Therefore, casters should stand at max range while burning him down.

Meshlok the Harvester.text: «N12237» is a level 48 elite, rare spawn inside Poison Falls who patrols the waters near the beginning and looks very similar to either a «N12223» or «N12224», so make sure you hover your mouse or use a /tar Meshlok macro to check to see if he is spawned. If he is not, «N12224» will patrol in his place. He isn't very challenging. Tanks, tank him away from the group. Ranged, spread out if possible to avoid his «S11876», and healers, be aware that he can interrupt your spell casting with «S15501».

Celebras the Cursed.text: «N12225» is a level 49 elite found at the end of Poison Falls. He summons non-elite «N13743» to constantly spawn during the encounter. He will most often use his «S9739» spell, which can be interrupted, so make sure it's getting interrupted as often as possible. If one of his «N13743» falls, he will summon another one. Focus down «N12225» first, then polish off the remaining «N13743».

Landslide.text: «N12203» is a level 50 elite Behemoth found in Poison Falls. He has many similar abilities to the «N12206» that you fought on the way to his alcove. Keep him near the area in which he stands. Tanks, tank him with your back to a wall. Ranged, stay at max distance to avoid any knockback or stun from the «N11783», who despawn once «N12203» dies.

Rotgrip.text: «N13596» is a giant level 50 white crocolisk elite found in Poison Falls. He patrols in the water of Zaetar's Cave — the area in which you just defeated «N12201». Drop down into the water to engage him. Be sure the surrounding area is clear, as there are also lingering Hydras in the water. He hits hard! Make sure your tank has proper aggro before everyone else engages. Healers, try your best to keep your tank and other party members topped off. «N13596» can dish out devastating damage quickly using his two abilities: «S15976», a physical damage-over-time, and «S16495».

Tinkerer Gizlock.text: «N13601» is a level 50 elite goblin found in Poison Falls. Tanks, face him away from the group to prevent group damage from his «S13183». Everyone else — stack close together in melee range. This will prevent «N13601» from being able to use his ranged abilities. With this strategy in mind, he shouldn't be difficult to burn down.

Princess Theradras.text: Although considered the final boss, most groups will head to «N12201» after killing «N12203», and then jump down to kill «N13596» and «N13601» after. You'll fight more groups of «N12206» before encountering «N12201», this time in packs of 2 — focus down one at a time. «N12201» is a level 51 elite found in Poison Falls. She is not an easy fight, so understanding her mechanics is vital. Groups tend to engage her towards the back of her cavern to allow for more space. She has a group of Fear called «S21869»; «S6346», «S18499» & «S8143» are all spells to help with this effect. She also has a pesky group knockback ability, «S21868», which not only pushes you back but damages as well — at max range, non-melee players should be able to avoid this. Also, be aware that there are non-aggressive turtles in the area around her cavern: if they get hit with a spell, they will aggro on you, so be mindful of your surroundings.

Interrogator Vishas.text: «N3983» doesn't involve much strategy. He's usually pulled with one additional humanoid, but as long as no additional mobs are aggro'd during the encounter, it's a straightforward tank and spank fight. Watch out for his DoT abilities. Abilities: «S9034»

Azshir the Sleepless.text: «N6490» has several magic abilities, including a fear. Make sure the area is clear before engaging him, as the fear can lead someone into additional mobs. Be wary of his «S5137», which can inflict damage even after his death. Abilities: «S5137» «S9373» «S7399»

Fallen Champion.text: The «N6488» encounter is straightforward, consisting of cleaving melee attacks. All DPS should stand behind him to avoid his «S7369». Abilities: «S7366» «S15496»

Ironspine.text: «N6489» is a simple tank and spank encounter. Healers, keep an eye on your party's health when Ironspine casts «S3815», as it can deal quite a bit of damage. Abilities: «S21007» «S3815»

Bloodmage Thalnos.text: «N4543» mostly casts spells, so it will be a heavy magic damage fight. He casts several AoE magic abilities in his close proximity, so ranged should keep their distance and healers should keep a close eye on the tank and melee. Abilities: «S9613» «S8814» «S12470»

Houndmaster Loksey.text: «N3974», the first boss you'll encounter, is accompanied by 3 elite «N4304». The hounds can be crowd controlled with anything that works on beasts, such as «S12824». A general strategy: crowd control one of the hounds, have the tank keep «N3974» busy while the DPS kill the hounds, then focus down «N3974». Be aware that he will «S6742» at low health. Abilities: «S4304» «S11549» «S6742»

Arcanist Doan.text: Tank Arcanist Doan in the middle of the room with the ranged spread to the edges. When he casts «S9435», everyone must run as close to the edges as possible. Healers, keep up heals on the group when he casts «S1449» and be wary of his «S30225». Some groups opt to bring «N6487» into the center of the previous hall and use the pillars to LoS his «S9435». Don't forget to pick up the key from the chest in his chamber after you kill him — it's required to access the Armory and the Cathedral. Abilities: «S9438» «S9433» «S9435» «S13323» «S8988»

Herod.text: The tank should keep him in the center of the room while the ranged spread out up the stairs. When he casts «S1680», he'll start to whirlwind, shout "Blades of Light!" and become immune to magic. Anyone near the center should run out to avoid devastating damage — do not try to tank this. When «N3975» dies, have everyone group up, because more than 20 non-elite «N6575» will run into the room and can easily be AoE'd down. Abilities: «S22540» «S8269» «S8260» «S8989»

High Inquisitor Fairbanks.text: Not a particularly challenging fight; he is found lying on the ground until you engage him. He casts «S16098» on a party member that can be dispelled. Watch out for him also casting «S6213» and «S700» on party members, as well as «S17» on himself. Interrupt his «S6064» and you've got him. Abilities: «S8282» «S12039» «S11647» «S8399»

Scarlet Commander Mograine.text: He's your typical paladin-type boss. Watch out for his «S853» and his ability to «S642». After you defeat him, «N3977» will run out from behind the altar and that fight will begin. Abilities: «S8990» «S853» «S14518» «S9257» «S642»

High Inquisitor Whitemane.text: «N3977» mainly casts «S25054» as her primary attack. After you get her health down to a certain point, she'll cast an unavoidable group «S700» on your party, allowing her to cast «S9232» on «N3976» and heal both back to full health. Have your tank pick up «N3976», burn down «N3977», then finish off «N3976». Some groups may kill her before she uses «S9232», but then the party will be unable to loot «N3976». Abilities: «S9481» «S12039» «S9256» «S22187» «S9232»

Blood Steward of Kirtonos.text: «N14861» is a level 57 elite located in the Reliquary. She has a few curses that can be dispelled. Watch out for her «S3609» as it stuns the target for 8 seconds. With those two things in mind, DPS her down! Abilities: «S22371» «S11708» «S3609»

Kirtonos the Herald.text: «N10506» is a level 60 elite located out on the porch; he can only be summoned if someone in your group has the summoning item. Tank, grab aggro and keep your back to a wall to prevent knockback. In human form, «N10506» uses his caster abilities — have someone dispel the curse, especially if it's on your healer. Once «N10506» transforms into his gargoyle form, it becomes a tank and spank fight so long as your tank maintains aggro. Abilities: «S22371» «S11708» «S3609»

Jandice Barov.text: «N10503» is a level 61 elite who is found by using a torch on the south wall. «N10503» will create several copies of herself that spread throughout the room. You can't AoE them down, so you must target them down individually. Some parties opt to ignore the adds and just focus down Jandice herself. Remember to have someone dispel her «S8282». Abilities: «S8282» «S18647»

Rattlegore.text: «N11622» is a level 61 elite located in the Great Ossuary's Basement. Pull «N11622» once your surrounding area is clear. His abilities are melee focused, and he hits like a truck! Ranged, keep back as far as possible. Tank, face «N11622» away from the group. Armor reducing abilities such as «S11597» or «S11198» can help your team take him down quicker. Abilities: «S18945» «S15580» «S11876» «S11597» «S11198»

Marduk Blackpool.text: «N10433» is a level 58 elite located in the Viewing Room. Tanks should hold «N10433» in place while ranged stand back, ensuring they are not affected by his «S17695». Melee, watch out for his «S12040» — it deals damage each time you attack him as long as it's active. Other than those two factors, he's pretty easy to burn down. Abilities: «S11609» «S17695» «S12040»

Vectus.text: «N10432» is a level 60 elite located in the Viewing Room. «N10432» is a pretty squishy target with fire-based spells. Watch out for his AoE abilities: don't stand in the fire and you'll DPS him down pretty quickly. Abilities: «S13021» «S10216»

Ras Frostwhisper.text: «N10508» is a level 60 elite located along the passage through the Viewing Room. Make sure the entire area surrounding «N10508» is clear before engaging. He has several frost-type magic spells and abilities. Tank, face him away from the group, watch out for his «S6215» and plan an interrupt rotation to minimize his spell casting. Abilities: «S18099» «S18100» «S6215» «S16350» «S8398»

Instructor Malicia.text: «N10505» is a level 60 elite located in the southern room on the upper floor. «N10505» has a few heals at her disposal, so be sure to sort out an interrupt rotation to minimize her casting. Have someone dispel her «S5137» curse and DPS her down. Abilities: «S5137» «S25311» «S6064» «S25315» «S6146»

Doctor Theolen Krastinov.text: «N11261» is a level 60 elite located in the eastern room on the upper level (The Hall of the Damned). Have your tank pull «N11261» and keep their back to a wall. At 50% health, his attack speed will dramatically increase — a great time to use defensive and healing cooldowns. He has melee-only abilities, so keep the tank alive and burn him down! Abilities: «S11130» «S11574»

Lorekeeper Polkelt.text: «N10901» is a level 60 elite located in the northern room on the upper level. «N10901» has several toxic AoE abilities that are damaging when nearby. One strategy to keep him at max range: have someone in your party pull «N10901» and jump off the upper-level railing, and as «N10901» runs around the stairs, your tank picks him up on the lower level. The rest of the party, remaining on the upper level, can attack him safely without worrying about his AoE abilities. If anyone is infected with his «S3586», make sure they spread out from the group. Abilities: «S8245» «S5413» «S3586»

The Ravenian.text: «N10507» is a level 60 elite located in the southern room on the lower level (The Barov Family Vault). «N10507» should be tanked against a wall, facing away from the rest of the group. It's a melee-centric fight, and he hits pretty hard and fast. Watch out for his AoE abilities and make sure the tank has generated enough threat before engaging. Abilities: «S20569» «S11130» «S25174» «S5568»

Lord Alexei Barov.text: «N10504» is a level 60 elite located in the eastern portion of the lower level (The Barov Family Vault) and is considered one of the toughest bosses in Scholomance. Two skeletal bodyguards accompany him; they hit pretty hard but can be CC'd with «S10955» or «S10326». The room he's in has toxic green liquid on the floor that you must not stand in. His AoE aura «S28340» constantly ticks damage to anyone in range, so tanks must pull Alexei back at max range so the aura doesn't afflict the rest of the group. His «S17820» can be very hard on the group if not cleansed: if you can't cleanse the curse, healers, keep the tank topped off as best you can — when «S17820» strikes, you'll have a lot of difficulty healing your tank for 15 seconds. Abilities: «S25309» «S28340» «S17820» «S10955» «S10326»

Lady Illucia Barov.text: «N10502» is a level 60 elite located in the northern room of the lower level (The Barov Family Vault). The biggest concern with fighting «N10502» is her ability to «S14515», a mind control mechanic. Be sure to stun or CC whoever is afflicted with «S14515». She can also cast an AoE «S12528» and «S6215», so make sure her entire area is clear before engaging. Abilities: «S11713» «S14515» «S6215» «S12528» «S17289»

Darkmaster Gandling.text: «N1853» is a level 61 elite located in the center of The Barov Family Vault, and spawns once you kill the last of the previous six bosses — so don't stand in the center and prematurely aggro him. Many tanks keep «N1853» in the center where he spawns while the ranged stay atop the stairs. He'll periodically teleport a player to an adjacent room, where they are locked in until they defeat the enemies inside — be prepared in case your tank or healer gets teleported. An interrupt order works nicely for «S25346». Have someone dispel «S17802» as quickly as possible. Other than that, he has a lot of HP, so execute the mechanics properly and you'll be rewarded! Abilities: «S25346» «S18702» «S12040» «S17802»

Avatar of Hakkar.text: Head to the west side of the Pit of Sacrifice and you’ll enter the Sanctum of the Fallen God . Clear the trash along the way and to prepare for the encounter. «N8443», a level 48 elite, cannot be summoned unless someone in your group has from the quest OR, has already completed the aforementioned quest and has , which allows the player to summon «N8438» without the egg. Kill the adds until a «N8438» spawns. Kill it and grab the from the corpse. Groups usually keep Free-for-All loot on in this encounter so one designated person can loot the bloods. (Don't forget to switch it back after Hakkar spawns!) Using the blood, you can extinguish one of the four braziers in the room. Proceed until another «N8438» spawns, and all of the braziers are extinguished. If everyone moves close to a wall before extinguishing the final brazier, you can drop combat before engaging the «N8443». The fight itself is pretty straightforward. He'll cast «S12888» on a random player. The best strategy is to stun or CC that player until they're returned to normal. If possible, Dispel «S10896», too. Otherwise, DPS him down and prepare for victory!

Jammal'an the Prophet.text: Now that all 6 Atal'ai Defenders are dead, the way to «N5710» is now open. Head on back towards the start of the instance and head left.

Ogom the Wretched.text: Now that all 6 Atal'ai Defenders are dead, the way to «N5710» is now open. Head on back towards the start of the instance and head left.

Dreamscythe.text: After «N5710» has fallen, the two drakes «N5720» & «N5721» will spawn in the Pit of Sacrifice . They’re relatively easy to burn down. Tanks should tank with their backs to a wall, keeping the drakes facing away from the party to avoid their frontal cone and knockback abilities.

Weaver.text: After «N5710» has fallen, the two drakes «N5720» & «N5721» will spawn in the Pit of Sacrifice . They’re relatively easy to burn down. Tanks should tank with their backs to a wall, keeping the drakes facing away from the party to avoid their frontal cone and knockback abilities.

Hazzas.text: After killing «N5720» & «N5721», two more drakes, «N5722» & «N5719», will spawn in the hallway right outside the Chamber of the Dreamer . Fighting Hazzas and Morphaz is the same strategy as the previous two drakes. Try not to pull both at the same time and avoid any trash in the area. These are the last two big kills before «N5709».

Morphaz.text: After killing «N5720» & «N5721», two more drakes, «N5722» & «N5719», will spawn in the hallway right outside the Chamber of the Dreamer . Fighting Hazzas and Morphaz is the same strategy as the previous two drakes. Try not to pull both at the same time and avoid any trash in the area. These are the last two big kills before «N5709».

Shade of Eranikus.text: «N5709», a level 55 elite, will summon any leftover dragonkin in the instance to his side, so it’s important to make sure you’ve cleared them all before pulling the boss. Ranged, stay out of melee range to avoid his AoE stun ability, «S16740». The target with the highest threat will get afflicted with «S12890». Players can use anti-aggro abilities such as «S10941», «S1038» and «S11303» to help control who gets afflicted with «S12890». Melee, never stand in front of the boss and be wary of his «S16740» ability. DPS him down following the mechanics and you’ll be fine. It’s a long fight so healers, be sure to keep an eye on your mana pool!

Lord Roccor.text: Arguably, «N9025» is one of the easiest bosses in . Level 60 druids are able to solo this boss, which indicates just how easily he can be defeated. «N9025» is incredibly easy. There is nothing really to look out for. «S13728» can interrupt casting, which is about the only real concern on this boss.

High Interrogator Gerstahn.text: «N9018» is the first boss many will face their first time in ! She is not exceedingly difficult overall, but can cause problems if you don't compensate for some of her mechanics. Killing her is necessary to obtain the , which is used to complete quests in the Detention Block . Overall, the approach to beating her is fairly simple. Her use of «S13704» is the most challenging part of the encounter as it can lead to other packs being pulled. For Horde Shamans, use tremor to deal with the fear. For Alliance Dwarf Priests, use fear ward. Further, warrior tanks can attempt «S18499», but the inability to effectively time and predict the fear makes utilizing this more about luck than timing. As for other tank/healer combinations and for DPS, attempt to wedge yourself deeply in a corner to attempt to mitigate some of the fear effects. Apart from the fear, dispel «S14032» and interrupt the «S14033».

Houndmaster Grebmar.text: «N9319» is another fairly easy boss fight. He shouldn't cause issues as long as he is handled appropriate to his patrol path. «N9319» pats around the room between two packs of hounds. Kill the pack of hounds opposite of his patrol path. Then, when he pats back, kill the other pack. Once both packs are dead.

Ring of Law: Gorosh the Dervish.text: «N9027» is like a warrior with «S15589» and «S15708». Maximize healing output outside of the «S15708» debuff. It is an easy fight as long as healer can sustain through the use «S15708».

Ring of Law: Grizzle.text: «N9028» is incredibly easy. There is nothing really to look out for. «S13728» can interrupt casting, which is about the only real concern on this boss.

Ring of Law: Eviscerator.text: «N9029» is more annoying than difficult. «S28599» can be rather annoying, but it shouldn't kill the group. That said, priests can utilize «S16874» to their advantage here. The additional shadow resistance makes the fight trivial.

Ring of Law: Ok'thor the Breaker.text: «N9030» is the most difficult boss within Ring of the Law because of the number of abilities. He plays like a mage, and bad «S14621» luck could lead to a wipe. The key is to dispel the «S14621» and have as many members stay at range as possible to minimize the effect of «S26192»

Ring of Law: Anub'shiah.text: «N9031» is almost as difficult as «N9030». «S15470» and «S15471» both need an immediate dispel. These are the difficult mechanics. The rest aren't too tricky. No real strategy needed other than the dispels.

Ring of Law: Hedrum the Creeper.text: «N9032» is a fairly straightforward boss. No real strategy is present outside of cleansing the poisons and dispel the Immobilize.

Pyromancer Loregrain.text: «N9024» is an optional boss that spawns near the Shrine. It is an incredibly easy fight. Skipped unless farming . «N9024» does not really warrant discussion of strategy outside of destroying to totem. Incredibly easy boss to kill.

Warder Stilgiss.text: «N9041» spawns with «N9042». The fight is not difficult for a five man group. Just kill «N9041» first and then «N9042» next.

Verek.text: «N9041» spawns with «N9042». The fight is not difficult for a five man group. Just kill «N9041» first and then «N9042» next.

Fineous Darkvire.text: «N9056» is an optional boss once you complete the quest required to kill him. As such, many groups opt to avoid him because it is a pain trying to clear all of the adds to reach him. «N9056» is a rather straightforward boss. He hits incredibly hard and has a healing mechanic. As such, it is important to interrupt the heal and for healers to pre-cast heals to keep up with the damage output. Further, when poorly geared, it is important to make sure all the adds along the pathway are killed to avoid an accidental aggro causing a wipe.

Lord Incendius.text: «N9017» is an optional boss, but most groups (even those doing Lava Runs ) tend to grab him as he is an easy kill. He is also located by the Black Anvil, needed by Blacksmiths . «N9017» is not difficult, but tanks and group members need to make sure they don't get knocked off the platform because there is no getting back up outside of dying.

Bael'Gar.text: «N9016» is an optional boss that most groups skip because he is not important to the advancement of the dungeon. «N9016» spawns adds, which needs to be kill. Also, tanks need to face «N9016» away from the group «S13880» is not a major concern if that is done. Outside of the tank taking a lot of damage, this fight is fairly easy.

General Angerforge.text: «N9033» is an optional boss, but a lot of players will want to farm it for and . Overall, the fight is fairly difficult because of the adds. If your group is lacking on AoE damage, the fight is harder than it would otherwise be. «N9033» is straightforward. He behaves like a warrior, and then calls adds during the encounter. Just burn him and AoE the adds when they come. They have fairly low health, so they die fairly easily.

Golem Lord Argelmach.text: «N8983» is an another optional boss that most avoid after the first few runs. It is one of the more challenging fights in , which is one reason why many avoid the fight all together. The primary reason to enter this room is for the , which is near «N8983». Every raid will want an engineer who is able to craft this item, so be prepared to visit a lot. «N8983» is a difficult fight because of «S15305». It is an unrelenting amount of damage if you're group is stacked too close together. As such, the real key to this fight is remaining spread out so that «S15305» doesn't freely bounce from target to target, which is the major killing mechanic on this fight.

Guzzler.text: There are a series of encounters in The Grim Guzzler that are covered in the Blackrock Depths Quest Guide , so I won't spend a great deal of time covering the minor encounters, such as and . However, «N9502» will be discussed as it is the primary encounter within The Grim Guzzler. The Grim Guzzler is a bar in Blackrock Depths featuring neutral patrons as well as the vendors «N9499» and «N12944». However, you may want to get into barfights with the patrons to complete quests or kill bosses.

Phalanx.text: To get through the room quickly just buy 6 from «N9499» to give to «N9503». After three turn-ins of to «N9503», he will start to rage. This action causes «N9502» to activate to stop «N9503». The door to the remainder of the dungeon is smashed open during the scuffle. «N9502» hit fairly hard with «S14099», but this does not warrant a lengthy strategy discussion. The group may be tempted to throw these bottles at patrons as the tool tip explains, but refrain from doing this as they will become angry. The other method to reach the next room past the Grim Guzzler is not as easy. This involves doing , which allows Nagmara to seduce Rocknot.

Ambassador Flamelash.text: «N9156» is a DPS race is some sense. There are adds that spawn which rush to the boss. If they reach the boss, he gets a buff. However, these adds can easily be killed before reaching him. As such, the way to beat him is to kill the adds before they reach him and increase his damage beyond which the healer is able to heal. «N9156» summons adds continually throughout the encounter, which give him a buff if they reach him. As such, these adds need to be killed away from the boss. Keep his stacks low, and this is an incredibly easy fight.

Panzor the Invincible.text: «N8923» is a rare boss spawn within The Mold Foundry. He is fairly annoying to casters because of «S9941», but outside of that, he is a fairly easy encounter. «N8923» is not a mob that will be encountered often. However, when encountered, the biggest thing is for casters to watch out for «S9941». other than that, it is an easy encounter.

Chest of The Seven.text: is another fairly easy fight. This is a multistage encounter against 7 waves of dwarven spirits. Each spirit reflects a particular class (e.g., priest, warlock, and rogue); however, it isn't worth offering unique strategy for each. They are all quite easy to kill. The only concern is killing them too slowly, which might mean you get an additional dwarf before you've completely killed the one you're focusing as they are released on a set timer. No real strategy other than killing each quickly. They will possess one or two abilities of their specific class, but in a weakened state. Try to kill them quickly to avoid fighting two or more at a time. The names of the seven dwarves are: Hate'rel Anger'rel Vile'rel Gloom'rel Seeth'rel Doom'rel Dope'rel

Magmus.text: «N9938» is a tricky fight because of the fires coming from each side throughout the chamber. «N9938» stands at the end of a long chamber. WIthin the chamber, there are two rows of fire belching golems. This fire is brutal and will kill you rapidly. As such, it is on the tank to put «N9938» in a good position, so that the flames aren't an issue. Outside of the flames from the sides of the chamber, the fight is fairly easy. This fight is all about positioning the boss correctly.

Princess Moira Bronzebeard.text: This is the final boss encounter within BRD. Groups can proceed in one of two directions. Either they can choose to save «N8929» and kill «N9019», or they can choose to kill both. Most groups will save «N8929» to complete the quest and then kill her each time afterwards because she had good drops.

Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.text: This is, unquestionably, the most difficult encounter of the dungeon, so be prepared for a fun fight. However, if you're a warrior tank or dps, get super comfortable, you'll live here while working on obtaining . If you are choosing to save «N8929», then your strategy is to keep her occupied with an off-tank, or someone who can interrupt her casts. because she can be fairly squishy. Further, she assists «N9019» within the fight, so you can't allow her to simply free cast the entire encounter. As soon as «N9019» dies, she breaks free from the mind control she was under to become friendly. However, if your intention is to kill «N8929», then you burn her before killing «N9019». Make sure you have some form of interrupt because she can do a fair amount of damage, which can be hard to heal through coupled with the damage output of «N9019». Looting «N8929» can be buggy; make sure your group has completed the / chain first.

Highlord Omokk.text: «N9196» is a level 59 elite ogre located in Lower . «N9196» is accompanied by two other Ogres. Most groups tend to CC one of the adds, while the tank picks up «N9196», keeping him away from the group, with their back against a wall due to Omokk's «S18945». Decide within your group how to handle the adds. Either CC both if possible and kill «N9196» first, or keep one add CC'd the entire time, kill the other, then Omokk. The choice is yours, but be sure crowd control is involved because it will make this encounter a lot easier. «N9196» himself hits pretty hard, so healers, be sure to keep an eye on the tank's health, especially if it gets low. With his «S8269», he could dish out devastating damage, quickly.

Spirestone Battle Lord.text: «N9218» is accompanied by two casters. Most groups opt to burn down the casters first and then move on to «N9218», but you can also use CC here if you'd like. He's a typical melee mob, so make sure the tank has aggro before burning him down.

Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin.text: «N9236» is a level 59 elite troll located in Lower . «N9236» is accompanied by two «N9240»s. Similar to «N9196», groups typically will CC one of the mobs, and pull «N9236» away from the group. This is due to her «S22566», which can affect multiple group members at a time. Kill her both «N9240»s first, then focus down «N9236». If you have a or in the group, have them cleanse her «S8282».

War Master Voone.text: «N9237» is a level 59 elite troll located in Lower . «N9237» is not accompanied by any guards, but he hits really hard. Do not engage in the fight until you're certain tank has generated enough threat to maintain aggro. Tanks - pull him close to a wall and keep your back to the wall. If «N9237» switches targets, stop DPS until the tank gets him back.

Bannok Grimaxe.text: «N9596» is a highly sought-after rare spawn in Lower , because he has a chance to drop . He spawns in the room before «N10596», among packs of orcs, by a cluster of tents. Be sure to use /tar Bannok to see if he's spawned. If he is, he's either sitting or sleeping in a corner.

Mother Smolderweb.text: «N10596» is a level 59 elite spider boss found within Lower . «N10596»'s «S16104» is an AoE frontal cone stun. So naturally, have your tank face her away from the group. She will periodically cast Mother's Milk , a poison that stuns her target and anyone within close proximity of them. Being attentive to these 2 abilities, you can burn her down relatively easy.

Crystal Fang.text: «N10376» is a rare spawn found in the area around «N10586»'s lair, in Lower .

Urok Doomhowl.text: «N10584» is a level 60 elite summoned boss found within Lower . When «N10584»'s encounter begins, many waves of elite ogres will appear first, before Urok himself. The key is to utilize the pike that you placed in the Tribute Pile. Every 30 seconds, you can click on the pike while targeting an ogre to insta-kill single ogre from a wave. This will help manage the number of mobs you fight at once per wave. Don't forget to also utilize CC in addition to clicking the pike, as these waves can get overwhelming over time. After you kill about 10 or so, «N10584» will finally appear. He's has warrior type abilities, including his «S16508» fear. Make sure your tank has proper aggro before unleashing DPS on him.

Quartermaster Zigris.text: «N9736» is an elite boss found within Lower .

Halycon.text: «N10220» is an elite worg boss found within Lower . «N10220» comes with a group of «N10259». Tanks, pick up «N10220» while the group kills the pup adds. Once the adds are done for, focus down «N10220». With her melee abilities, «S13443» and «S3391», she shouldn't be too challenging to take down. As soon as «N10220» falls, replenish your health and mana ASAP, because «N10268» will soon come running into battle!

Gizrul the Slavener.text: «N10268» is an elite worg boss found within Lower . «N10268» hits pretty hard and combined with his abilities, can dish out devastating damage with «S20539», which will heal himself, and «S16128», a nature DoT. As usual, have your tank pick him up and generate enough threat before you unleash your DPS on him.

Overlord Wyrmthalak.text: «N9568» is the final boss of Lower . Tanks, face «N9568» away from your party, with your back against a wall while generating your initial threat. He will summon adds during the fight when he reaches 50% health. Most groups will opt to CC the adds and burn «N9568» down as quickly as possible, then move on to the adds once he's down.

Pyroguard Emberseer.text: This room is straightforward. Click the Altar to aggro all of the Incarcerators to release the bind on Pyroguard Emberseer . Once released, kill Pyroguard to advance into The Rookery. Click the Blackrock Altar to start the fight. The Incarcerators have low health, so killing them is quite easy. Just AoE them down with mages and locks. As for Pyroguard, tanks should keep him away from the group to avoid multiple people getting hit with the fire nova. Outside of that, this fight is quite easy. Boss should die fairly quickly.

Solakar Flamewreath.text: This room is a major wipe risk because of the eggs on the ground. Most groups avoid the Father Flame event in this room and continue around the West wall to reach the upper landing overlooking The Rookery . However, some groups opt to do the event, which is quite difficult. To start the encounter, reach Father Flame by hugging the Northern wall tightly as a raid and walking down to the far end. It is wise to clear out a few of the eggs before starting the encounter, but be aware that they will respawn fairly quickly. As such, some groups avoid focusing on this because it is seen as a futile effort. Clear out the dragonspawn before beginning the event. Then, click Father Flame and loot the item. During the event, multiple waves of mobs will come at your raid. The first is the Rookery Hatcher. They will break the eggs, so it is critical to kill these mobs immediately. Have your mages and warlocks deal with the released whelps. The second mob type of the Rookery Guardian. Have your tanks grab these mobs and tank them back against the Eastern wall. The targets have lower priority than the Hatchers. After a few minutes, Solakar will come, which is a simple encounter. Have your tank grab Solakar and position him along the wall. Finish off the remaining whelps, and then have your group focus on Solakar. Have your raid stay at range. He has a war stomp, which can stun the whole raid. Once killed, your raid should hug the wall again and work your way back around the edge of the room and up the landing. AoE whelps as they spawn, but it is possible to avoid cracking multiple eggs by hugging the corner.
