Jed Runewatcher.text: Just as with Goraluk , this fight is quite easy. Tank him back against the wall with raid group at range, which should lead to a straightforward kill. Charge Shield Bash Heroic Strike Note : Some groups will do a /tar Jed Runewatcher before beginning the run. This is where the origin of the chat message "LFM UBRS doing Jed/Rend" runs comes from.

Goraluk Anvilcrack.text: This room is straightforward. The boss in this room is Goraluk Anvilcrack, but the optional boss Jed Runewatcher might also present within the Hall. Clear all the mobs then kill Goraluk Anvilcrack and Jed if present. Some groups skip this room as both are optional bosses. This fight is a basic encounter. Tank him against the wall apart from your group. Backhand Head Crack Heroic Strike

Gyth.text: Complete the gauntlet to beckon Rend and Gyth. The gauntlet consists of numerous waves of orcs and dragonspawn. Once completed, the Southern Gateway will open allowing passage into The Furnace. After seven to eight waves, Rend will appear riding on Gyth’s back. To combat Gyth , the MT should face Gyth away from the raid to protect them from the breath. At 20%, Rend will be knocked off Gyth’s back. The raid should kill Gyth before switching to Rend. Freeze Corrosive Acid Breath Flame Breath Your OT should immediately grab Rend as soon as he is knocked off Gyth , and position him to the side of the room. Once Gyth is slain, the raid will switch to Rend . Melee should attempt to avoid his whirlwind and cleave mechanics. He hits quite hard, so healing here is the biggest issue with killing Warchief Rend Blackhand as mana is already low going into this portion of the encounter. Whirlwind Thunderclap Cleave

Warchief Rend Blackhand.text: Complete the gauntlet to beckon Rend and Gyth. The gauntlet consists of numerous waves of orcs and dragonspawn. Once completed, the Southern Gateway will open allowing passage into The Furnace. After seven to eight waves, Rend will appear riding on Gyth’s back. To combat Gyth , the MT should face Gyth away from the raid to protect them from the breath. At 20%, Rend will be knocked off Gyth’s back. The raid should kill Gyth before switching to Rend. Freeze Corrosive Acid Breath Flame Breath Your OT should immediately grab Rend as soon as he is knocked off Gyth , and position him to the side of the room. Once Gyth is slain, the raid will switch to Rend . Melee should attempt to avoid his whirlwind and cleave mechanics. He hits quite hard, so healing here is the biggest issue with killing Warchief Rend Blackhand as mana is already low going into this portion of the encounter. Whirlwind Thunderclap Cleave

The Beast.text: The goal here within The Furnace is to kill The Beast . Berserker Charge Immolate Flamebreak Fear The Beast is a decently difficult fight because of a few mechanics. The first is a charge that can’t be avoided. As soon as the charge happens, he will return to the top aggroed target. The MT should always have the most aggro to ensure it returns properly. The second mechanic that will cause issues is the fear. Raid groups should be at max range and spread out from The Beast to avoid this mechanic. Finally, there is a fire nova ability called Flamebreak that will do fire damage and cause a knockback. Tanks should have their back to a wall to avoid being knocked back. Everyone else should attempt to back at max range to avoid taking too much AoE damage.

General Drakkisath.text: This is the final room within Upper Blackrock Spire . General Drakkisath , the final boss, is located here. There are a few patrols within this room as well as stationed mobs. Kill General Drakkisath to complete the raid. Cleave Conflagration Flame Breath Thunderclap General Drakkisath is the most difficult by far. The most common approach is the kite method, which many groups with hunters will use. It is significantly easier than the other method. In the kiting method, the hunter will pull General Drakkisath and kite him back through into the Beast’s room. Once there, the Hunter with feign death returning Drakkisath to the raid. While this is going on, each tank will grab a Chromatic Elite Guard and burn it down. The MT will then be prepared to grab General Drakkisath . Face him away from the raid to account for the flame breath. General Drakkisath is easy on his own apart from the guards, which is why this method is favored amongst raid groups. The second strategy is similar, but without the kite. Your group can tank both the adds and General Drakkisath at the starting position. The goal is to AoE Cleave the Chromatic Elite Guards down quickly. A possible assist here is to chain fear one of the guards with a warlock, which lessens the healing burden. Either way, this method is significantly harder at lower gear levels because of the damage output between the guards and General Drakkisath . Once the guards are dead, just as with the kiting method, General Drakkisath is fairly easy on his own.

Darkstone Tablet.text: Faction: Horde Level Required: 57 Rewards: or 8,300 experience reputation with - begins with «N5204» in , who gives you : «N5204» She asks you to find «N9078», in Kargath, : «N9078» «N9078» will follow up with, , asking you to bring him . This is found inside Upper , inside The Rookery, with all of the eggs. (the Leeroy Jenkins room)

Pusillin.text: Once you engage «N14354», he will summon four (4) «N13276» to his side. Once your tank grabs aggro on «N14354», your group can AoE down the imps. «N14354» casts a variety of Fire spells - «S1769», «S2139» and other interrupts can prevent his casts from going off. Casters: watch out for his «S22735», which is a self-buff increasing his size, melee haste by 20% and chance to reflect spells by 50%.

Zevrim Thornhoof.text: «N11490» will periodically teleport a party member to his ritual alter and cast «S22651». Healers: whoever is targeted by this will need BIG heals! His other spell, «S22478» is like an AoE «S10894» that can be dispelled. Ranged, stand max distance to avoid this. If you have a in your group, one tactic is to enslave a «N11457» or «N11456» and use them to attack «N11490».

Hydrospawn.text: «N13280» could be approached in 2 ways. Burn him down & ignore the «N14350» that he spawns, or AoE down the «N14350» then switch over to «N13280». The «N14350» do tend to cause more damage than «N13280» himself, so if you choose to just burn him down quickly, keep an eye on your healers and interrupt spells when you can.

Lethtendris.text: «N14327» has a plethora of -related spells. Her «S22709» is a 4-second cast and should be interrupted, as should most of the spells you see casting. She afflicts a couple of curses, so if you have a or , be sure to have them decurse the group. Her imp, «N14349» also casts a variety of fires pells. He has about 1/3 of her HP, so focus down the imp first then move on to «N14327».

Alzzin the Wildshaper.text: «N11492» will shape-shift into different forms. When he shape-shifts, make sure your tank reestablishes aggro before DPSing. In his initial, Satyr Form, be sure to cleanse the poison «S22661» right away as it acts as a periodic mana drain. Be sure to cleanse the disease spell, «S22662», as well. Both can be interrupted, so watch out for his spell casting. When he shifts into treant form, his armor increases by a lot, so using like «S11599» and «S11198» will help you get through this phase. He can also shape-shift into a Dire Wolf, casting abilities similar to a feral in «S768». At 35% health, the wall will crumble behind him and a group of non-elite adds will come running out. They're pretty easy to AoE down and finish burning down «N11492».

Guard Mol'dar.text: «N14326» is a named ogre guarding the approach to Dire Maul North. He uses only melee-focused abilities, so the fight is not too challenging as long as your tank picks up aggro quickly and the ranged stay back to avoid «S10101» and «S15749». On a tribute run, do not kill him — hug the northern wall and sneak past instead.

Stomper Kreeg.text: «N14322» is the drunken ogre chef dancing along the northern ramp — hard to miss. His «S22833» hits the whole party, getting everyone drunk and reducing their chance to hit by 75%. Other than that it is a straightforward tank-and-spank melee fight. On a tribute run, do not kill him — wait for him to fall asleep and sneak past.

Guard Fengus.text: «N14321» patrols the center of the Courtyard. Like «N14326», he is all melee — keep the tank on him and let the ranged stay back to avoid «S10101» and «S15749». On a tribute run, do not kill him: stealth classes can wait for him to patrol away and loot the chest in the middle, or a class with a movement speed ability can dash in and grab it.

Guard Slip'kik.text: «N14323» patrols the winding hallway into the Halls of Destruction. On the way, kill the «N14386» on sight or it will summon two «N14389». Like the other guards, «N14323» is melee-focused — tank him up close and keep the ranged away from «S10101» and «S15749». On a tribute run, do not kill him — set a freeze trap on the broken trap on the ground so he gets caught when he patrols back.

Captain Kromcrush.text: «N14325» hits very hard and can fear party members with «S19134». At around 50% health he will summon two «N11450» to his side — be ready to control the adds and keep the tank's aggro on «N14325». Casters should stay at max range, as with the other guards. On a tribute run you can skip this fight entirely by wearing the Gordok disguise and talking your way past him.

Cho'Rush the Observer.text: «N14324» is King Gordok's caster attendant. In a normal run, burn him down first — he supports «N11501», so keep his casting interrupted. On a tribute run he must survive: once «N11501» falls, «N14324» becomes friendly and stops attacking.

King Gordok.text: «N11501» is the final fight of Dire Maul North and the target of the tribute run. Deal with «N14324» first in a normal run (see his entry), then burn the king down. On a tribute run, killing «N11501» while keeping «N14324» alive yields the Gordok Tribute.

Tendris Warpwood.text: Clear all of the ancients in the area before pulling «N11489», otherwise they will all aggro together. Watch out for his AoE melee knockdown «S5568» — ranged should stand well back. «S22994» is a root effect that can be dispelled. Wait for the tank to build threat, then burn him down.

Illyanna Ravenoak.text: «N11488» fights just like a hunter, accompanied by her pet bear «N14308». All of her abilities except «S22910» can be negated by standing in melee range of her. Most groups burn down «N11488» first, then kill «N14308».

Magister Kalendris.text: «N11487» is a shadow priest-type caster. Interrupt his spells, dispel any magic off the party, and burn him down; extra shadow resistance helps a lot.

Tsu'zee.text: «N11467» is a rogue-type silver elite found near the ramps in the Court of the Highborne, in Dire Maul West. Fighting «N11467» is like encountering a rogue, and she hits pretty hard — make sure your tank gains aggro before attacking. Dispel «S21060» from your party if able, then burn her down.

Immol'thar.text: «N11496» will summon eyes around the room — assign someone, preferably a ranged attacker, to dispose of them. He will cast «S8269» at 50% health, so healers should be ready with big heals on the tank. He also randomly teleports players to the middle of the room — if it is the tank, let them run back and re-establish aggro. Clear all the mana pylons first so his shield drops.

Prince Tortheldrin.text: «N11486» hits hard and fast. Tank him in the corner to avoid his knockback «S22920». After casting «S22920» his aggro resets — cease DPS until the tank gets him back, then burn him down quickly.

Lord Hel'nurath.text: «N14506» is a special boss in Dire Maul West that can only be summoned by warlocks carrying the three summoning items from their epic mount quest line. The ritual takes place at the altar where «N11496» originally stood, after that boss is dead. The group must survive many waves of demons while the warlock keeps all three ritual items active; «N14506» himself is then a straightforward kill.

Skul.text: «N10393» is a rare spawn you may encounter just before «N11058», with another spawn point on the east side of the dungeon. His mechanics are very simple — he just casts spells, which you should interrupt to reduce damage.

Hearthsinger Forresten.text: «N10558» is another rare spawn, appearing north up the lane from «N11058», or east past «N10516» along Market Row. He casts an 8-second sleep on a random player, and his multi-shot «S14443» can be countered by spreading out a little.

The Unforgiven.text: «N10516» spawns in the corridor labeled 4 on the map, together with a few non-elite adds, so do not engage while already fighting other mobs or at low health and mana. He has no real mechanics beyond the adds and a shadow spell that also slows.

Postmaster Malown.text: «N11082» mobs throughout the instance drop keys that open their associated mailboxes. Opening the third mailbox spawns «N11143» along with three elite «N11142» that use «S7713» — the stacking curse gives tanks and healers a hard time, so crowd control the adds or have a mage or the healer dispel it off the tank. Make sure the area is clear before engaging, as his fear could send you running into extra mobs.

Timmy the Cruel.text: «N10808» is the first boss you may encounter if you head straight for the Scarlet side. He is a reference to South Park and yells "TIMMY!" on engage. He has no mechanics — a simple tank and spank.

Malor the Zealous.text: «N11032» has no notable mechanics apart from «S17233». He is located in his own room at number 7 on the map; the chest behind him contains the item for the related quest, plus some gold and random items.

Crimson Hammersmith.text: Summoned by clicking the blacksmithing plans on the floor at number 8 on the map. A simple tank and spank; he only drops plans for blacksmiths with the Armorsmithing specialization.

Cannon Master Willey.text: «N10997» spawns at number 9 on the map. He summons several ranged adds during the fight — either switch to them, or grab a cannon ball near «N10997» and load it into one of the cannons to shoot them down. He has an interrupt, but apart from that the fight is simple as long as the adds are handled.

Archivist Galford.text: «N10811» spawns at number 11 on the map, in a room tied to two quests — loot what you need before burning down the room. He has a DoT «S17293» and an AoE ability, which makes the fight harder on healers; if the DoT lands on the tank, be ready for heavy damage.

Balnazzar.text: «N10812» is the final boss of the dungeon at number 11 on the map, and turns into «N10813» halfway through the fight. In human form he does little, but around half health he gains «S17405», «S13704», «S15587», «S17399» and «S15970». Crowd control the player he mind controls, stand at max range to avoid the fear if you are a caster, and dispel the sleep off your allies when you can.

Magistrate Barthilas.text: «N10435» can spawn at the church near the start, or — if alerted — run to his second spot near the end of the instance at number 12 on the map. The key ability to watch for is «S14099»: it knocks the tank back several yards, potentially into more mobs. Simply face your back to a wall so you get knocked straight up instead of backward.

Stonespine.text: «N10809» is a rare spawn that appears at 14 on the map and paths up and down that section. He has no notable mechanics apart from «S14331», though he does drop some decent gear.

Baroness Anastari.text: «N10436» spawns at number 15 on the map. She does not hit hard, but her kit is annoying: she casts «S17244» on players throughout the fight — the possessed player is freed by being brought to 50% health — silences casters, and curses players to reduce their hit chance. After she dies, clear the room behind her full of «N10399», as this unlocks a gate later in the dungeon.

Black Guard Swordsmith.text: «N11121» is a mini boss summoned by clicking the blacksmithing plans on the ground to the right of «N10436». He has no mechanics and no unique loot apart from a plan for blacksmiths.

Nerub'enkan.text: «N10437» spawns at number 16 on the map, northwest of the gauntlet entrance, and is usually the first boss you make your way to. As DPS, cleave down the extra mobs he spawns — they do little damage, and you may pull aggro anyway because the tank is snared or under pressure. Healers and tanks should watch for «S6016» and coordinate defensives and focused healing. After he dies, clear the room behind him full of «N10399» to unlock a gate later on.

Maleki the Pallid.text: «N10438» is down the path north of «N10436», at 17 on the map. He will generally entomb the tank in «S16869», which lasts 6 seconds — during that time healers and DPS should watch their threat. That is the only mechanic worth worrying about. After he dies, clear the room behind him full of «N10399» to unlock a gate later on.

Ramstein the Gorger.text: «N10439» spawns at number 18 on the map after you kill all the patchwork mobs in the room. The gate into the room locks once you start pulling, so let your group know, and pull the patchworks one at a time — they hit hard and can spawn extra mobs. «N10439» himself is basically a tank and spank with aggro swaps: he casts «S17307» on the tank and swaps aggro, using «S5568» along the way, so healers should keep some heals ready for the DPS.

Baron Rivendare.text: «N10440» is the final boss of the undead side. His kit reduces healing on the tank and deals consistent AoE damage with his aura and cleave, and he summons skeletons throughout the fight — cleave them down quickly or they will wreak havoc. A proven strategy: buff up outside and run in together, as the door closes on pull. The tank runs right and pulls him to the right side of the room with the melee; ranged DPS and the healer stand on the bone piles on the left to avoid «S17467». Melee should stay behind the boss to avoid his cleave. When skeletons spawn, switching to them is the DPS priority — they die quickly and the tank does not need to pick them all up. Keep your distance from the aura and the fight becomes much easier.

Saltspine.text: A very simple fight as long as you clear out the nearby mobs first. Saltspine casts Thunder Clap (3604) on the tank — a heavy slow that does not change how you play — and periodically Dust Storm (1316382) on everyone within 10 yards, reducing attacks' chance to hit by 25%; casters should stay out of melee range.

Shadetooth.text: Shadetooth is joined by two Thicket Hunters (260801); fighting all three at once is very difficult unless overleveled — either CC the adds for the whole fight, or CC one and kill the other first. Dispel the Hunters' poison quickly. Once only the boss remains: Tendon Rip (12054) hits the tank moderately, and Terrifying Roar (14100) is a 5-second undispellable fear — easy to get feared into grass-spawned raptors or uncleared adds. Clear the crocodile cove to the left and fight there; the Hunters cannot swim, so dragging the boss back into the previous boss area resets it. The boss can be slowed and stunned, which is especially useful during Frenzy (18501) below 30%.

Highland Horror.text: Wowhead's guide has no dedicated strategy box for this fight. It is the target of the Alliance quest "Horrors in the Highland" — kill it inside the dungeon and bring the root core back to Rethiel the Greenwarden.

Relic Guardian.text: The encounter starts by pressing the Archival Panel on the right side of the inactive boss. This is a gear and level check: the difficulty comes from high tank damage and a large health pool. The boss casts Thunder Clap (15588) on everyone within 10 yards — a heavy movement/attack-speed slow plus moderate damage. The tank is periodically knocked back and sometimes stunned for 5 seconds. The boss can be stunned and slowed: use CC liberally and kite between the nearby structures.

Hand in and accept next quest.text: Alliance players can access the dungeon through the sewers in Dalaran. The first time you visit the city, you will have to run from Hillsbrad Foothills to get to the city, which is a bit of a hike. Horde players have to enter through a special tunnel where the «N269127» grants us special access to help defend the city. To unlock the gate, at least one player needs to have access to . You can easily reach the dungeon by swimming from . Once you land in The Sepulcher, it only takes a few minutes to reach the dungeon on foot. As with many World of Warcraft: Forever Dungeons, wiping (the entire group dying) in City of Dalaran can be a frustrating time due to the long run-back. Ideally, if the entire group is not dead, you should be able to get a rez (resurrection). This is a spell someone casts on you to bring your character back to life with a small amount of health and mana. Priests, Druids, and Shamans learn this early; Paladins need to complete a quest to learn resurrection and may not have it. If you can't get a rez, click to release your spirit, then run back to the dungeon from the Spirit Healer (marked on the map below) as a ghost. You collect your body when you enter the instance. Best Quest Rewards.text: Step 2: Travel to Ambermill Exit Shadowfang Keep and run over to the Dalaran-controlled town of Ambermill in . In the keep, you will find the Ambermill Leyline Focus, and if you interact with while you're next to it, it will turn the Black Tome into Entrance to City of Dalaran Step 3: Enter the City of Dalaran At this point, you have all you need to summon «N247032». Clear the first boss «N247126», then continue through the sewer. Instead of heading right to get to the surface, continue straight forward into the tunnel leading to a purple rune on the ground. Interact with , and Lyn will appear after a short RP entrance with a nod to «N11502». Too soon, you have awakened him too soon . You will encounter «N247126» very early in the dungeon, and as a consequence, he's a very easy tank-and-spank style boss. His primary mechanic is summoning Skeletons, non-elite mobs, that need to be killed. They don't have any time-sensitive mechanics, and the only way you die during this encounter is if you use heavy AOE before the tank has established threat, so be careful. This boss is essentially designed to test the strength of your tank with abilities like «S1303264», «S3391», and «S12057». Make sure to put on a shield for this encounter. The boss will also periodically use «S6713» on the tank.

Atrexis the Grave Knight.text: You will encounter «N247126» very early in the dungeon, and as a consequence, he's a very easy tank-and-spank style boss. His primary mechanic is summoning Skeletons, non-elite mobs, that need to be killed. They don't have any time-sensitive mechanics, and the only way you die during this encounter is if you use heavy AOE before the tank has established threat, so be careful. This boss is essentially designed to test the strength of your tank with abilities like «S1303264», «S3391», and «S12057». Make sure to put on a shield for this encounter. The boss will also periodically use «S6713» on the tank.

Arcane Anomaly.text: «N245999» is one of the bosses you can kill after exiting the sewers and has a core defining mechanic that will kill you if mishandled. «S1241501» is an arcane slicer that cuts across the room and rotates counterclockwise. This is a mechanic many raiders will be familiar with if they played WoW before picking up Forever and can be seen in bosses like C'thun, Halion, and Norushen. Make sure to avoid this ability, or you will die. Another thing to keep in mind is that the boss spawns small adds at the edge of the room when you engage it, so make sure to stay within the circle on the platform to avoid pulling them into the boss. The boss will periodically cast «S15230» in addition to its normal melee attacks.

Arcanic Enigma.text: «N246016» has 2x «N269475» accompanying him as you begin the fight. These should be burned down quickly, as they have a Mana Burn that is very taxing on whoever is targeted. «S1240869» will occasionally CC a group member for 8 seconds and needs to be dispelled by someone with the ability to dispel Magic. Speaking of dispelling Magic, it may be a good idea for your healer to stand far away from the rest of your group, as the boss will cast an AOE «S1224125» on targets close to the boss. The boss will continuously spawn small «N246893» throughout the fight, and they need to be cleaved down. These are not as much of a priority as «N269475», but the boss will not spawn additional Mana Phantoms during the encounter.

Unstable Sentinel.text: «N246017» has one defining mechanic, and that is «S1241329». Malfunction will have a short wind-up before unleashing heavy AOE damage to anyone within 25 yards. Ranged players should stay at max range for the entire fight, and melee players should run out whenever you see the wind-up. Depending on your level and group composition, you could likely stay in as a melee, but being kind to the healer should be the baseline. Note: Non-elite enemies called «N254856» will spawn from the buildings as you approach the boss. Kill these before engaging the fight to make things a little bit easier.

Mana Devourer.text: «N246008» resides by the entrance to Violet Hold and can be deceptively difficult. The boss will periodically cast «S1240750», which deals damage to everyone within 45 yards and drains 200 mana. Additionally, the boss will cast «S1240738» on the current target, dealing arcane damage on impact and over a 10-second duration. This boss is essentially a rush against time, as the group will sooner or later run out of mana unless you defeat the boss quickly enough. The boss is also immune to arcane spells. Note: Make sure to clear out all the trash in the boss area. They will join the fight after engaging the boss if they are still alive.

Fel Ancient.text: «N246003» has two mechanics that are quite unforgiving. «S22994» will occasionally root 2 targets and deal damage over time. This is not a big deal on its own, but when combined with his other mechanic «S1240706», it can be quite deadly. Fel Timbers leaves a green pool on the ground that deals damage to anyone standing in it. If Entangle and Fel Timbers overlap, make sure to use effects like «S1044» or «S20589» to clear it. Note: «N246003» is only unlocked once surrounding bosses are defeated and the mana barrier protecting him is broken.

Lyn the Ignored.text: «N247032» is a secret boss hiding away in the sewers. After summoning him, you'll have to deal with a surprisingly punishing encounter. «S17228» will be cast periodically and deals a surprising amount of shadow damage. On its own, it's not too difficult to handle, but when combined with damage from «S1304473», things can get scary. This ability gives your attacks a chance to cause damage to yourself, which is bad news for melee classes, particularly Rogues. This is a curse, so make sure to dispel it if possible. The boss will also cast «S1303266», which summons two non-elite skeletons, similar to «N247126».

Shade of the Archmage.text: «N246020» is the final boss of the dungeon. The Archmage uses his mana pool to use his abilities, and once that mana pool is drained, he will use «S1303598» and «S1303599» to regenerate his mana to full. His primary damage ability on the tank is «S15230», which deals high steady damage. He'll also periodically use «S28450», which deals moderate damage to anyone within 20 yards. Occasionally, the Archmage will cast «S1241515», which deals high damage to anyone hit. This will target one individual player with an arcane boomerang projectile, and anyone standing in the projectile will take damage. Stay spread out to avoid spreading the damage from Bounding Mana, and casters stay at max range to avoid taking damage from Arcane Explosion. Casters who are looking to squeeze a bit more damage or healing out of the fight can hide behind the wall whenever the boss casts Mass Polymorph, but be careful, as if the boss leaves his room, he will fully reset.
